summary: Auddia Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Warrant Exchange Agreements dated November 6, 2026 with holders of its publicly traded warrants (issued via an April 2026 registered offering and 2023-2025 private placements). Each Existing Warrant converts into two common shares: an initial 580,023 warrants for 1,160,045 shares, plus, subject to stockholder approval, 4,135,539 warrants for 8,271,077 shares. The exchange relies on Section 3(a)(9) exemption with no commissions paid. This is a liability-management/equity issuance, not a special situation; watch dilution and the stockholder vote needed for the larger tranche.
